description: The PXL standard library (spec Appendix E.3, ADR-0009). Every overload has a permanent ID; the VM calls overloads by ID and never inspects types. Single capital letters are type variables; `enum` accepts any enum.

groups.name: regex
groups.description: Bounded regular expressions shared by Go and Dart.

groups.name: phone
groups.description: Phone-number validation from libphonenumber metadata; formatting is in the format group.

enums.name: RoundingMode
enums.description: How division and rounding discard digits (PXL-005); halfEven is the default.

enums.name: DateStyle
enums.description: The length of a formatted date.

macros.name: map
macros.description: Transforms each item: items.map(x, expr) is the list of expr for every x.

macros.name: filter
macros.description: Keeps the items for which the predicate holds: items.filter(x, pred).

macros.name: any
macros.description: Whether the predicate holds for at least one item: items.any(x, pred).

macros.name: all
macros.description: Whether the predicate holds for every item: items.all(x, pred).

macros.name: sortBy
macros.description: Sorts items by a key, ascending and stable: items.sortBy(x, key).

functions.name: len
functions.description: The number of code points in a string.

functions.name: upper
functions.description: Upper case by simple one-to-one Unicode case mapping.

functions.name: lower
functions.description: Lower case by simple one-to-one Unicode case mapping.

functions.name: trim
functions.description: Removes leading and trailing Unicode White_Space.

functions.name: contains
functions.description: Whether s contains sub.

functions.name: startsWith
functions.description: Whether s starts with prefix.

functions.name: endsWith
functions.description: Whether s ends with suffix.

functions.name: replace
functions.description: Replaces every non-overlapping occurrence of old, left to right; an empty old leaves s unchanged.

functions.name: split
functions.description: Splits s at every sep; an empty sep splits into code points.

functions.name: join
functions.description: Joins the items with sep between them.

functions.name: substring
functions.description: The code points from start (inclusive) to end (exclusive, default the length); indices outside 0 ≤ start ≤ end ≤ len fail with indexOutOfRange.

functions.name: padLeft
functions.description: Prepends pad, a single code point, until s has width code points.

functions.name: padRight
functions.description: Appends pad, a single code point, until s has width code points.

functions.name: matches
functions.description: Whether s matches the regular expression, a bounded RE2 subset.

functions.name: abs
functions.description: The absolute value; abs of the smallest int fails with overflow.

functions.name: min
functions.description: The smaller of two values; money values must share a currency.

functions.name: max
functions.description: The larger of two values; money values must share a currency.

functions.name: round
functions.description: Rounds half to even unless a mode is given: a double to an int, a decimal to a scale (default 0), money to its currency's minor units.

functions.name: floor
functions.description: Rounds toward negative infinity: a double to an int, a decimal to scale 0.

functions.name: ceil
functions.description: Rounds toward positive infinity: a double to an int, a decimal to scale 0.

functions.name: clamp
functions.description: Limits x to [lo, hi]; lo > hi fails with invalidArgument.

functions.name: int
functions.description: Converts to int: doubles and decimals truncate toward zero; strings must be optionally signed digits.

functions.name: double
functions.description: Converts to the nearest double; strings use the JSON number syntax.

functions.name: decimal
functions.description: Converts to a decimal: a double by its shortest round-trip form, a string in plain notation.

functions.name: money
functions.description: A money value; the currency must be an ISO 4217 code.

functions.name: add
functions.description: Exact addition, as +.

functions.name: sub
functions.description: Exact subtraction, as −.

functions.name: mul
functions.description: Exact multiplication, as ×.

functions.name: div
functions.description: Division rounded to a scale (money: its minor units) with a mode (default halfEven); a zero divisor fails with divisionByZero.

functions.name: currency
functions.description: The currency code of a money value.

functions.name: amount
functions.description: The amount of a money value.

functions.name: isZero
functions.description: Whether the value is zero.

functions.name: compare
functions.description: Compares two values: -1, 0 or 1.

functions.name: date
functions.description: A date from YYYY-MM-DD, from year, month and day, or the local date of a dateTime; years are 1–9999.

functions.name: dateTime
functions.description: A dateTime from RFC 3339 with an offset; fractions beyond milliseconds are truncated.

functions.name: duration
functions.description: A duration from milliseconds, or from ISO 8601 [-]P[nD][T[nH][nM][n[.fff]S]] (days are 24 hours).

functions.name: addDays
functions.description: Adds calendar days; for a dateTime, days of 24 hours in its offset.

functions.name: addMonths
functions.description: Adds months, clamping the day to the end of the month.

functions.name: diffDays
functions.description: The days from a to b.

functions.name: startOfDay
functions.description: Midnight of the same day in the same offset.

functions.name: toCalendar
functions.description: The year, month and day of a date in another calendar system.

functions.name: fromCalendar
functions.description: The date of a year, month and day in another calendar system.

functions.name: weekday
functions.description: The ISO weekday, 1 (Monday) to 7 (Sunday), in the local time of a dateTime.

functions.name: isBefore
functions.description: Whether a is before b.

functions.name: isAfter
functions.description: Whether a is after b.

functions.name: size
functions.description: The number of items or entries.

functions.name: isEmpty
functions.description: Whether the collection or string is empty.

functions.name: first
functions.description: The first item, or null for an empty list.

functions.name: last
functions.description: The last item, or null for an empty list.

functions.name: at
functions.description: The item at index i, or null outside the list.

functions.name: slice
functions.description: The items from start (inclusive) to end (exclusive); indices outside 0 ≤ start ≤ end ≤ size fail with indexOutOfRange.

functions.name: sum
functions.description: The sum; 0 for an empty list.

functions.name: distinct
functions.description: The items without repetitions, keeping first occurrences; items must be scalars.

functions.name: keys
functions.description: The keys, in code-point order.

functions.name: values
functions.description: The values, in key order.

functions.name: has
functions.description: Whether the map has the key.

functions.name: format.number
functions.description: A number formatted for the user's locale.

functions.name: format.money
functions.description: A money value formatted for the user's locale.

functions.name: format.date
functions.description: A date or dateTime formatted for the user's locale.

functions.name: format.percent
functions.description: A ratio formatted as a percentage for the user's locale.

functions.name: format.compact
functions.description: A number in compact form, such as 1.2K, for the user's locale.

functions.name: format.phone
functions.description: A phone number formatted for a region.

functions.name: format.iban
functions.description: An IBAN in groups of four, upper case, without other spaces.

functions.name: t
functions.description: The translation of a key in the user's locale, with arguments.

functions.name: plural
functions.description: The form for n under the locale's plural rules; forms are keyed by CLDR category.

functions.name: coalesce
functions.description: The first argument that is not null; expanded inline into ??.

functions.name: ifNull
functions.description: a unless it is null, then b; the same as a ?? b.

functions.name: isNull
functions.description: Whether the value is null.

functions.name: typeOf
functions.description: The static type of the expression as a string, computed at compile time.

functions.name: string
functions.description: The canonical text of a value: ES6 number text for doubles, plain notation for decimals, "12.50 EUR" for money, ISO 8601 for dates, dateTimes and durations, #RRGGBBAA for colors.

functions.name: isEmail
functions.description: Whether s is an ASCII e-mail address: a local part of up to 64 characters, a domain of at least two labels of up to 63 characters and an alphabetic top-level label, at most 254 characters in total.

functions.name: isPhone
functions.description: Whether s is a valid phone number for the region.

functions.name: isIban
functions.description: Whether s is a structurally valid IBAN with a correct mod-97 check; spaces are ignored.

functions.name: isNumeric
functions.description: Whether s is optionally signed digits with an optional fraction.

functions.name: luhn
functions.description: Whether s is at least two digits passing the Luhn check.
